verdict.rationale: A probe found a live llms.txt at qualcomm.com (HTTP 200), so an agent has a machine-readable entry point. That file is a company-wide Qualcomm summary, not documentation specific to the X2 Elite Extreme. The product's own spec page serves only a JavaScript shell to non-browser fetchers, and the markdown developer-docs path returns 404, so agents cannot easily read the product docs directly. Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented content for the X2 Elite Extreme, crawler-readable spec pages, markdown versions of developer docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use these docs.
